title: Ungraded Lab: Market Research Team
module: Module 5 - Patterns for Highly Autonomous Agents

notes.goal: Build an automated multi-agent marketing pipeline that researches fashion trends, matches them with an internal product catalog, generates a campaign visual and quote, and compiles an executive report.

steps.title: Setup Tools and Environment
steps.what_happens: Load environment variables, set up the aisuite client, and test the search and product catalog tools to ensure external data access.

steps.title: Run Market Research Agent
steps.what_happens: The agent queries live web trends for summer sunglasses and reviews the internal product catalog to recommend items that fit current fashions.

steps.title: Run Graphic Designer Agent
steps.what_happens: Transforms the research brief into an image generation prompt and caption, then invokes the image model to save a visual asset.

steps.title: Run Copywriter Agent
steps.what_happens: Analyzes the generated image alongside the trend summary using multimodal capabilities to craft a short, elegant campaign quote.

steps.title: Run Packaging Agent
steps.what_happens: Rewrites the trend summary for an executive audience, combines all assets into a formatted Markdown report, and saves it locally.

notes.results: The pipeline executed successfully through all 12 model calls, gathering trend data, generating campaign visuals, writing marketing copy, and compiling a complete executive report without errors.
try_next: Modify the market research agent prompt to target winter ski eyewear instead of summer sunglasses.
Change the copywriter agent instructions to generate a longer, punchier slogan instead of a short quote.
Add a review agent step that checks the executive report quality before saving it to disk.
Swap out the image generation model parameters to alter the aspect ratio or style of the campaign visual.
